check.description: Run all quality checks (PHP lint + PHPCS + PHPStan + JS lint)
check.template: Run composer check and npm run check:js. Report all errors found. Do NOT autofix — only report what's broken.

check:fix.description: Run all quality checks and autofix what can be autofixed
check:fix.template: Run composer phpcbf && npm run lint:js:fix && npm run lint:css:fix && npm run format. Report what was changed.

build.template: Run npm run build. Verify build/index.js and build/index.css exist after. Report any build errors.

test.template: Run composer test:php and npm run test:js. Report all pass/fail results.
